title: Mast Cell Stabilizers (Cromolyn Sodium & Ketotifen): Mechanism of Action & Therapeutic Uses

notes.text: A concise, newly authored revision guide for this topic. Use the video for the instructor’s full explanation; these notes do not claim to transcribe it.
Prevention rather than immediate bronchodilation is the pharmacologic role of mast-cell stabilizers.
Acute bronchospasm is not rapidly reversed by cromolyn.
After watching, explain the key mechanism in your own words. Identify one distinguishing feature and one important limitation or complication, then answer the questions below.
